label: preparing
what: A surprise feast/celebration for the mayor at the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, aiming for 200 loaves and using eight installed lanterns. Builder, freight, innkeeper and neighbour coordinated supplies, baking, delivery and keeping the feast secret; baker knowingly supplied celebration bread, including barter and credit. Mayor knew of lighting inspection and later provisioning/committee business, but the record supports that the celebration itself had not been disclosed. Secretary did not knowingly help conceal it: she declined confidentiality and attempted disclosure, reportedly unheard. Watchman involvement is unsupported.
